neutral_facts.fact: August counts the 350 sq ft that qualified for 27 days
neutral_facts.reason: the example uses 300 (the cap) for August through December

neutral_facts.fact: the business is a cash-method sole proprietorship with $20,000 gross receipts and no expenses
neutral_facts.reason: the example gives no business income; the simplified deduction cannot exceed the profit, so ample receipts keep the cap from binding

neutral_facts.fact: filer born 1980-06-15, rents the home, and the space is the principal place of business
neutral_facts.reason: the example gives none of these

expected.derivation: allowable square feet x $5 (Schedule C line 30 simplified method); the printed figure is the average monthly allowable square footage
